description: Use when the user asks what a customer is worth or whether acquisition pays back: lifetime value, LTV to CAC, CAC payback, gross margin per customer, for recurring (subscription), one-time and transaction (repeat purchase) revenue in any mix. Takes up to three revenue lines and three cost of sales lines, each typed Recurring, One time or Transaction, with churn, billing and repeat periods, a discount rate, CAC and retention costs. Returns LTV split by revenue type, the ratios, and one customer's monthly revenue, billings, costs and cumulative cash flow (discounted and not) from the month of acquisition (month 0) through month 48, or through the months input (12 to 120). Runs the same math as Hemrock's Unit Economics Tool spreadsheet, checked against the workbook. Send inputs with only what the user gave you; everything else takes the model's defaults, and the result echoes every input used, so tell the user which defaults mattered. Set months (12 to 120, default 48) for the length of the forecast; monthly results are arrays with one value per month, month 1 first, and the totals cover the same months. LTV counts at most ltvMonths months of a customer's life (1 to 120, default 60), whatever the forecast length. The result includes webUrl: give it to the user, because it opens this exact model in Hemrock's web version, where they can change any input and download the live Excel workbook. Free: signed in it uses no calculations; without an account it counts toward a few free runs a day.

inputs.description: The model inputs. Send only what differs from the defaults; anything left out takes its default.

billingPeriodMonths.description: Billing period, months. Separates cash collection from revenue; 12 bills annually

churnPeriodMonths.description: Churn period, months. Length of a renewal cycle: 1 for monthly, 12 for annual

costOfSales1.description: Cost of sales 1, % of revenue. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

costOfSales1Type.description: Cost of sales 1, type. Recurring = Recurring, One time = One time, Transaction = Transaction

costOfSales2.description: Cost of sales 2, % of revenue. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

costOfSales2Type.description: Cost of sales 2, type. Recurring = Recurring, One time = One time, Transaction = Transaction

costOfSales3.description: Cost of sales 3, % of revenue. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

costOfSales3Type.description: Cost of sales 3, type. Recurring = Recurring, One time = One time, Transaction = Transaction

discountRate.description: Discount rate, annual. Used to discount future cash flows in the LTV. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

discountRecurring.description: Discount on the first recurring billing. Total discount over the first billing period

ltvMonths.description: Months of customer lifetime in LTV. LTV counts at most this many months of a customer's life. Churn and discounting can shorten it further

months.description: Months of cash flow after acquisition. From 12 to 120. The monthly cash flows run from the month of acquisition (month 0) to this month

oneTimeMonth.description: Month the one-time revenue lands. 0 for an upfront fee

recurringChurn.description: Churn per period. Share of customers who don't renew each churn period. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

recurringMarginGrowth.description: Annual growth in gross margin per unit. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

repeatCost.description: Repeat and expansion cost, per repeat transaction

retentionCost.description: Retention and expansion cost, per renewal

revenue1.description: Revenue line 1, per unit. Average revenue per order, a subscription fee, a maintenance fee and so on

revenue1Type.description: Revenue line 1, type. Recurring repeats every billing period, one time happens once, transaction repeats on its own cycle. Recurring = Recurring, One time = One time, Transaction = Transaction

revenue2Type.description: Revenue line 2, type. Recurring = Recurring, One time = One time, Transaction = Transaction

revenue3Type.description: Revenue line 3, type. Recurring = Recurring, One time = One time, Transaction = Transaction

transactionChurn.description: Churn per transaction period. Share of customers who don't buy again. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

transactionMarginGrowth.description: Annual growth in gross margin per transaction. A fraction: 0.05 means 5%

transactionPeriodMonths.description: Months between repeat transactions. 0 for a single transaction that never repeats
